0-source-1.title: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 December 2022 on digital operational resilience for the financial sector
0-source-1.applicability: Defines core scope (Articles 2-3), proportionality principle (Article 4), simplified framework for smaller providers (Article 5), and management body accountability (Article 16). Directly applicable to all financial entities in EU.

passages.text: allowing for a proportionate application of requirements for certain financial entities, particularly microenterprises, as well as financial entities subject to a simplified ICT risk management framework.

To facilitate an efficient supervision of institutions for occupational retirement provision that is proportionate and addresses the need to reduce administrative burdens on the competent authorities, the relevant national supervisory arrangements in respect of such financial entities should take into account their size and overall risk profile, and the nature, scale and complexity of their services, activities and operations

0-source-2.title: DORA - Frequently Asked Questions | Central Bank of Ireland
0-source-2.applicability: National implementation guidance showing proportionality application (e.g., reduced incident reporting scope for smaller entities), management body resource allocation examples, and simplified framework eligibility criteria based on entity size/criticality.

passages.text: A simplified RMF is provided for certain types of FEs
Some specific requirements do not apply for microenterprises

The rules relating to the ICT Risk Management Framework (RMF) are required to be implemented proportionally, taking into account their size and overall risk profile and the nature, scale, and complexity of their activities and operations

concerns.description: Determination of financial entity scope under DORA Article 2-3, including exemptions and group boundary considerations
Application of proportionality principle per Article 4 based on entity size, risk profile, and operational complexity
Eligibility criteria for simplified ICT risk management framework under Article 5 for microenterprises and smaller entities
Management body accountability requirements per Article 16 including ownership, resourcing and ICT-risk oversight responsibilities
